name: Trivial
description: One function, a loop, stdout. Highlights startup cost and basic I/O.

name: Easy
description: Standard collections, input parsing and simple algorithms.

name: Medium
description: Non-trivial algorithms, recursion, memory-heavy work and file formats.

name: Hard
description: Concurrency, networking, long-running servers, frameworks or protocols.

name: Expert
description: Multi-service systems with external dependencies, interpreters or engines.
